name: labs/fredrik-qi__fork_fluent_sila2_connector
title: Tecan Fluent liquid handler
intro: Tecan Fluent liquid handler, adapted from fredrik-qi/fork_fluent_sila2_connector. It reads `state`, `progress`, `last_error`, `runnable_methods` and 1 more; runs `start_fluent`, `prepare_method`, `run_method`, `pause_run` and 9 more. `start_fluent`: start FluentControl or attach to a running instance without credentials; the connector may wait without a timeout and then prepares the method 'Method to prepare'. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
